Name: New Pet Displays by Nighty (DGA)
Author: NightshadowCat93
Description:
This mod allows you to place more cute animals/magical creatures and their habitats into your room!

In this mod you can find:

- a cute sparrow on a stand (recolor of the PD bird)
- a crow  on his stand (recolor of the PD bird)
- two cute bunnies sleeping in their little beds named Cinnamon and Pepper
- a colorful dyeing dart frog in a vintage terrarium
- a set of plants that contains a ficus bonsai ﻿and a peperomia coin
- a beautiful fish bowl (recolor of PD) but no fish in there cuz they don't belong in bowls so I put my pink planorbarius corneus snails in it, with a lot of plants so they can thrive 
- my irl hamsters that I love! I wanted to make a mod with proper habitats for hamsters and also to have my babies in-game. Please take care of them! you can adopt:

  [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url]Dango (Golden Campbell), male
  [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url]Kobe (Black and white Campbell), male
  [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url]Aki (Standard winter white), female
  [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url]Mochi (White winter white), male

BONUS: You can also have magical creatures from the Harry Potter world now! Here's what you can adopt:

  [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url]Fanny, Dumbledore's phoenix (recolor of PD parrot)
  [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url]A niffler in a hamster habitat (it's full of treasures), running on its wheel 
  [url=https://emojipedia.org/sparkles]✨[/url]Pygmy puff available in 3 different shades of pink
